Derek Toh is the founder and CEO of Hiredly, a recruitment and talent management platform based in Malaysia. Hiredly aims to connect job seekers with potential employers and to provide companies with innovative recruitment solutions.

Toh has extensive experience in the recruitment industry, having worked in various roles at leading companies such as Accenture and Hewlett Packard. He founded Hiredly in 2016 with the goal of transforming the way companies hire and manage talent in the digital age.

Under Toh's leadership, Hiredly has grown rapidly and has helped to streamline the recruitment process for many Malaysian companies. Toh has also been recognized for his contributions to the startup ecosystem in Malaysia, and has received awards such as the Top 40 under 40 Award by Prestige Magazine.

Derek wants to teach an Online MasterClass course with a total run time of 180 minutes that includes several lessons that last between 8 to 15 minutes each. Think like an Instructional Designer, the target audience for the course is Employed Malaysia, especially those in HR positions working in small to mid sized companies that would benefit from improving Employer Branding. Should should address all the issues commonly faced by employer and pain points of the target audience. Given that this is an experience based learning masterclass, write me a 20 lesson course outline that would localise the pain points to Malaysia, factor in Derek's personal and professional; and give me bullet points of what each lesson would cover. Also, suggest some titles for the course.

Course Title: Transforming Employer Branding for Small to Mid-Sized Companies in Malaysia

Course Description: This Online MasterClass, led by Derek Toh, CEO of Hiredly, will provide Employers in Malaysia with a comprehensive guide to transform their Employer Branding. This 20-lesson course will cover all the pain points and challenges commonly faced by Employers in Malaysia, and will provide actionable insights and strategies to attract and retain top talent.

Course Outline:

Lesson 1: Introduction to Employer Branding in Malaysia

* The importance of Employer Branding
* The current state of Employer Branding in Malaysia
* Key challenges faced by Employers in Malaysia

Lesson 2: Understanding Your Company's Unique Value Proposition

* How to identify and articulate your company's unique value proposition
* Understanding the importance of aligning your Employer Branding with your company's core values

Lesson 3: Building Your Company's Employer Brand

* Developing a strong Employer Branding strategy
* Creating a compelling Employer Value Proposition (EVP)
* Communicating your EVP effectively to your target audience

Lesson 4: Leveraging Social Media for Employer Branding

* The power of social media in Employer Branding
* Best practices for leveraging social media platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter
* How to measure the effectiveness of your social media campaigns

Lesson 5: Creating a Positive Candidate Experience

* The impact of candidate experience on Employer Branding
* Best practices for creating a positive candidate experience
* How to measure and improve your candidate experience

Lesson 6: Employer Branding and Recruitment Marketing

* The role of Recruitment Marketing in Employer Branding
* Developing a Recruitment Marketing strategy
* Measuring the effectiveness of your Recruitment Marketing campaigns

Lesson 7: Creating a Diverse and Inclusive Employer Brand

* The importance of diversity and inclusion in Employer Branding
* Best practices for creating a diverse and inclusive Employer Brand
* How to measure and improve diversity and inclusion in your company

Lesson 8: Building Your Employer Brand Through Employee Advocacy

* The power of employee advocacy in Employer Branding
* How to empower your employees to become brand ambassadors
* Measuring the impact of employee advocacy on your Employer Brand

Lesson 9: Leveraging Employee Engagement for Employer Branding

* The relationship between employee engagement and Employer Branding
* Best practices for improving employee engagement
* How to measure the impact of employee engagement on your Employer Brand

Lesson 10: Managing Your Company's Reputation Online

* The impact of online reputation on Employer Branding
* Best practices for managing your company's online reputation
* How to measure and improve your online reputation

Lesson 11: Crafting an Effective Job Description

* The role of job descriptions in Employer Branding
* Best practices for crafting an effective job description
* How to align your job description with your Employer Brand

Lesson 12: The Importance of Employee Onboarding for Employer Branding

* The impact of employee onboarding on Employer Branding
* Best practices for creating an effective employee onboarding program
* How to measure and improve your employee onboarding process

Lesson 13: Building a Strong Employer Brand on a Budget

* How to build a strong Employer Brand on a limited budget
* Low-cost Employer Branding strategies
* How to measure the impact of your budget-friendly Employer Branding efforts

Lesson 14: Leveraging Employer Branding to Improve Retention

* The relationship between Employer Branding and employee retention
* How to use Employer Branding to improve retention rates
* Measuring the impact of Employer Branding on employee retention

Lesson 15: Creating a Talent Pipeline Through Employer Branding

* The role of Employer Branding in creating a talent pipeline
* Best practices for leveraging Employer
